question: Which festival is celebrated in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu as a harvest festival dedicated to the Sun God?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pongal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pongal** is a traditional harvest festival celebrated in the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is dedicated to the **Sun God**, who is worshipped for ensuring a bountiful harvest.
 
• The festival marks the beginning of the Tamil month of **Thai**, which usually falls in mid-January.
